title: A state innovation fund opens a round — read and triaged

objects.subject: Seed Support round open until 31 Oct
objects.body:
Dear Founder,

Applications for the Sabarmati Seed Support round are open until 31 Oct. Eligible startups may apply for up to INR 25 lakh. See the portal for the criteria.

Sabarmati Innovation Hub

expected.brief: one line: a round you could apply to, closing 31 Oct
